title: Selected published Krillion Answers archive questions
scope: 48 selected distinct prompts, each with the complete official scored answer list returned by its public archive question page. The archive merges records from repeated appearances; these are published archive question lists, not uniform single-date scoring snapshots.
sourceDateMeaning: Latest appearance date for the selected exact prompt in the cached archive index. Individual answers can originate from older appearances; per-answer source paths are recorded below.
attribution: Questions, accepted answers and recorded rarity scores sourced from Krillion Answers, an independent archive of published Krillion reveals. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Krillion or Krillion Answers.
transformations: Selected 48 varied exact prompts from cached archive index.
Selected newest metadata record per exact prompt, verified all response promptIds refer to the same prompt or linked question page, and verified the full answer count.
Kept only short prompt text, canonical answer, official tier and score.
Excluded suggestions, unscored records, quips, prose, page code and branding.
Discarded index aliases because they contain broad prompt search keywords repeated across unrelated answers; aliases arrays are intentionally empty.
Removed only exact duplicate canonical strings with identical scores; retained punctuation and distinct canonical forms.
limitations: These are published archive scores, not live Krillion grading or a complete original game database.
A public question page can merge answers from multiple appearances. The sourceDate field is its latest appearance date, not a claim that all scores were recorded on that date.
The public lists may contain variants, outdated entries or inaccuracies from the archive; completeness means all published scored records for the selected snapshot.
No explicit reusable dataset license was found in the archive terms; retained factual question, answer and score fields with attribution.
